label: FACIS Simulation — Modbus Adapter
info:
FACIS Simulation — Modbus TCP Slave Adapter

Exposes the latest energy-meter snapshot as Janitza UMG 96RM-shaped
Modbus TCP holding registers on port 5020 (unprivileged; matches
docs/api/modbus-reference.md).

Register layout:
  19000-19006 active power L1/L2/L3/total (W)
  19020-19024 voltage L1-N/L2-N/L3-N (V)
  19040-19044 current L1/L2/L3 (A)
  19060      power factor (-)
  19062      total active energy (kWh)
  19064      frequency (Hz)

All values are IEEE 754 float32 in big-endian register pairs (ABCD,
high word first). FC 3 (Read Holding Registers) serves the block.

The register block refreshes every second from the shared
`latest_meters` global context written by the Feeds tab, delivered to
the modbus-server node as ONE byte-array block write: the node's write
path is byte-addressed at address*8 while reads are served from
register*2, so only a contiguous block copy at (base*2)/8 lands where
FC3 reads expect it (see the writer function).

Multi-meter MVP: one modbus-server node per meter, distinguished by
unit ID. Configure additional meters by duplicating the writer function
+ modbus-server pair and pointing each at a different `METER_INDEX`.
